boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of North Dakota, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence of campus and nearby Grand Forks stops: get oriented, move around, find culture, then choose a scheduled evening event.

cards.title: Start at the Social Stairs
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Memorial Union
cards.notes: Use the tiered seating as a simple meeting point, then check the Memorial Union’s services and building map before splitting off to explore.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor rendezvous point for beginning the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Memorial Union as the heart of campus, and its Social Stairs are a campus gathering space.
cards.source_title: Services & Amenities | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Memorial Union hours listed: Sunday 11 a.m.–midnight; Monday–Thursday 7 a.m.–midnight; Friday–Saturday until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Chester Fritz Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus research library
cards.notes: Walk through the library and identify a study spot, service desk, and the route back to your residence before the campus gets more familiar.
cards.short_summary: An orientation stop centered on UND’s main research library.
cards.evidence_claim: Chester Fritz Library is UND’s library for research, reference, library services and spaces, and collections.
cards.access_notes: Check the library website for current building access and service hours before going.

cards.title: See the current MUG exhibition
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Memorial Union, Room 140
cards.notes: Take a short gallery lap and read one label closely; rotating exhibitions make this an easy repeat stop when friends visit later in term.
cards.short_summary: A compact on-campus art stop with changing shows.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s Memorial Union Gallery hosts rotating exhibitions, with shows changing about every 90 days.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Gallery | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The gallery page lists exhibition-specific hours; confirm the current show and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Try the Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Bring your U Card, sign the required annual waiver if needed, and ask an attendant about beginner-friendly climbing before getting on the wall.
cards.short_summary: A beginner-accessible indoor climbing activity at the Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that no climbing experience is necessary and that the Rock Wall is available to UND students and Wellness Center members at no extra cost.
cards.source_title: Rock Wall | Wellness Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Access requires UND student or Wellness Center membership status; visit during Rock Wall operating hours.

cards.title: Play a round at NEXUS
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Ask the desk how to use the gaming PCs, then choose a short session that leaves time for the rest of the day’s campus exploration.
cards.short_summary: A named recreational esports lounge with gaming PCs.
cards.evidence_claim: UND identifies NEXUS as its recreational esports gaming lounge and says it has twelve gaming PCs.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Confirm current lounge availability and eligibility with the Wellness Center before visiting.

cards.title: Make time for table tennis
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Check out paddles and a ball at the welcome desk with your ID, then invite a new neighbor for a casual game between other plans.
cards.short_summary: A simple, equipment-supported indoor activity for two or more people.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that Wellness Center members can play table tennis and check out paddles and a ball free from the welcome desk using ID.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Table tennis is for Wellness Center members; bring ID and ask the welcome desk about equipment availability.

cards.title: Step into North Dakota Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 261 Centennial Drive
cards.notes: Browse the current exhibition at your own pace, then pause outside to orient yourself on the west side of campus before heading back.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with rotating exhibitions and no general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UND reports that North Dakota Museum of Art has no general admission, although it suggests a donation.
cards.source_title: NDMOA opening ‘Stories of Place: Select Recent Acquisitions’ exhibition Sept. 5
cards.access_notes: The cited UND notice lists museum hours as weekdays 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and weekends 1–5 p.m.; verify current exhibition hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a daylight Greenway walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Grand Forks riverfront
cards.notes: Choose a mapped segment, share your route with your group, and turn around with ample daylight so the walk stays a relaxed first-weekend outing.
cards.short_summary: An expansive public outdoor recreation area along the Red River.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Grand Forks describes the Greenway as a 2,200-acre outdoor recreational area spanning Grand Forks and East Grand Forks.
cards.source_title: Greenway | City of Grand Forks, ND
cards.access_notes: Use the City’s Greenway maps and activity information to select an appropriate route and conditions.

cards.title: Pause at University Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · 320 N 25th Street
cards.notes: Use the park as a calm reset between campus plans; in winter, check whether an outdoor-rink activity is scheduled before making it your destination.
cards.short_summary: A nearby named park that also hosts outdoor-rink programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s calendar lists University Park at 320 N 25th Street and identifies its Outdoor Rink as the location for rink scrimmages.
cards.source_title: University Park | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Outdoor-rink activities are seasonal; check the calendar and weather before traveling there.

cards.title: Choose an evening at the Chester Fritz
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 3475 University Avenue
cards.notes: Check the current event calendar, choose an age-appropriate performance, and buy tickets only if a scheduled show and your budget line up.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for concerts, theatre, dance, and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that the Chester Fritz Performing Arts Center hosts programming ranging from concerts and opera to ballet, symphonies, Broadway shows, and university events.
cards.source_title: Chester Fritz Performing Arts Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for many events; verify the current calendar, ticket policy, start time, and age guidance before attending.
